classification_main.panel_a: Per-class recall from frozen per_class.csv; no new uncertainty added
classification_main.panel_b: Paired image bootstrap stratified by true class, observed support fixed; percentile 95% intervals. Identical resampling weights for every model.
classification_main.panels_c_d: Difference of saved row-normalized confusion matrices, expressed in percentage points
interval_limits: Intervals condition on these fixed fitted models and observed class composition; they do not capture training-seed uncertainty.
Lesion/patient clustering is unavailable. Image-level intervals may be optimistic if images are correlated.
Accuracy McNemar tests are exact two-sided; their two baseline comparisons use Holm correction. Fourteen exploratory per-class recall tests use a separate Holm family.
Bootstrap intervals for multiple descriptive metrics are not multiplicity adjusted. Neither a small p-value nor a positive interval establishes clinical utility.
Training and test prevalence differ. Changing a selection rule or loss based on these test diagnostics would require a new held-out test set for confirmatory evaluation.

segmentation_main.dot_definition: One frozen full-volume metric per test case and method
segmentation_main.linkage: Paired case IDs; identical deterministic horizontal offsets in all panels
segmentation_main.summary: Black horizontal bars are arithmetic means; offset capped lines show population SD (ddof=0) across the 20 cases, not confidence intervals
segmentation_main.highlight_rule: Largest 3D U-Net HD95 across all 20 test cases

classification_precision_recall_by_class.input: Frozen per-class test metrics at argmax operating points
classification_precision_recall_by_class.uncertainty: No intervals added; class supports displayed
classification_precision_recall_by_class.interpretation: Precision and recall are different quantities; dashed equality line is a visual reference, not chance performance

classification_validation_test_alignment.selection: Existing metadata best_epoch; no new checkpoint selection
classification_validation_test_alignment.uncertainty: No new intervals or significance tests
classification_validation_test_alignment.interpretation: Validation and test refer to different dataset partitions; differences include sampling and class-composition effects

segmentation_metric_summary.uncertainty: Population SD describes cohort spread, not estimator uncertainty or confidence intervals
segmentation_metric_summary.raw_points: All saved case metrics are displayed without winsorization, filtering, or smoothing

segmentation_volume_bias.empirical_distribution: Right-continuous empirical CDF of absolute percent bias; n = 20 per method
segmentation_volume_bias.interpretation: Descriptive test-set diagnostic; no regression, association test, or new model selection
